thread:
Alice (Design): quick UX ping — want to validate the inspector + export flow for batch embeddings before the next release. main asks: column density, export CSV shape, and keyboard/aria nits. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (updated frames)
Ben (Product): high level: customers want a compact inspector when viewing 1k+ vectors. can we make collapse state default for >200 rows? :thinking:
Carla (Eng): collapsing by default is fine, but need to confirm server-side pagination vs client virtual scroll. collapsed rows still render previews; virtualizing heavy previews is better.
Devin (A11y): a11y note: when collapsing, ensure the toggle has aria-expanded and keyboard focus lands on the first interactive element inside expanded area. Also announce row counts to screen readers.
Emma (QA): found copy inconsistency: export modal says "Export vectors" in header but button reads "Download CSV". should match. Also verify that exported CSV includes header row with column ids.
Frank (I18n): tiny copy change request — avoid imperative text that doesn't localize well. prefer "Download CSV" -> "Download" + small helper text "Includes vector ids and scores" so translators can reorder.
Kira (Support): customer ask: can export include original source text as a column? many teams rerank with source context. If we add it, add opt-in toggle (off by default) for PII reasons.
Alice (Design): proposal: default compact inspector for >200 rows, expandable detail panel per row. export modal: primary button "Download CSV" + secondary text explaining columns. Include checkbox "Include source text" (off).
Ben (Product): regarding columns — recommended CSV shape:
```
vector_id,embedding_0,...,embedding_127,score,source_text(optional)
```
Make source_text optional and configurable in modal.
Carla (Eng): implementation note: export streaming should write embeddings as base64 or flattened floats? flattened floats are large. maybe compress JSONL gz for large batches.
Devin (A11y): accessibility for export modal: ensure focus trap, label modal by <h2> "Export embeddings", and keyboard shortcut Escape closes. Add aria-live polite region that announces "Export started" when user confirms.
Emma (QA): add test case: export with 5000 vectors, toggling source_text on/off, and verify header order and CSV parseability in Excel/LibreOffice.
Frank (I18n): please provide all UX strings in a single copy file for localization:
- Export modal title
- Checkbox label: "Include source text"
- Helper line: "Includes vector ids and scores"
- Primary button: "Download CSV"
I can take translations once final.
Kira (Support): accessibility + privacy ask: tin on the modal to state "Source text is stored in export only; do not upload to third-party services" — helps with ops questions.
Alice (Design): copy updates (proposal):
- Modal title: "Export embeddings"
- Primary: "Download CSV"
- Helper: "Contains vector ids, scores, and embeddings. Toggle to include original source text."
- Checkbox label: "Include original source text (opt-in)"
Would those be ok? keeps short and actionable.
Ben (Product): LGTM. also add a tiny footnote about max export size (e.g., "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports use background job") — product wants explicit limits.
Carla (Eng): background job + email link is doable. we should surface progress and a cancel button. backend will emit job id for tracking.
Devin (A11y): background job notifications need accessible updates — use live region or notification center that screen readers can query. job list should include status and a link with aria-describedby.
Emma (QA): checklist item: keyboard-only path for expanding a row, opening the export modal, toggling checkbox, and starting export. test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Frank (I18n): will prepare translation keys once copy is frozen. also ask to avoid concatenated strings where possible.
Kira (Support): can we add small snippet in modal with example CSV headers to reduce support tickets? a collapsed "Show example" toggle.
Alice (Design): yes — add collapsible example code block under helper text (collapsed by default). example should show truncated embedding columns.
design-bot: design review scheduled for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Reminder will be posted 24h before.
Ben (Product): action items: Carla to estimate effort for virtualized preview + background export job. Devin to write a11y acceptance criteria. Alice to update Figma copy and add example block. Frank to prep i18n keys. Emma to draft QA test plan. Kira to draft short modal support blurb.
Carla (Eng): estimate: virtualized preview ~3 dev days + QA. background export + jobs + tracking ~5 dev days. plus ops for storage. rough SLO: 1 sprint.
Devin (A11y): I'll post a short a11y checklist in this thread by EOD.
Alice (Design): thanks all — will push updated frames and copy in an hour. ping here with any blocking concerns. :rocket:
